description: This study abroad course introduces students to the life and thought of Niccolo Machiavelli as a window into Renaissance Italy, Ancient Rome, and Modern Europe. Students not only trace Machiavelli's career and aspirations through the streets of Florence and Rome, they also explore the way in which his political and literary works continue to shape the way in which Ancient Rome is presented to tourists and national identity is promoted by politicians. Offered alternate years during January term.
name: Politics and Power in Italy
notes: This is a study abroad course. You will find this course listed in Studio Abroad
title: Machiavelli's Shadow: Politics and Power in Italy
